title: Live official re-reads performed 2026-11-18 UTC (arena/f7037afe-own4)
method: Each official page below was read with the fetch tool on 2026-11-18 UTC and compared with the committed nfl-book dataset. PASS = every compared value matches. FLAG = a difference or an unresolved conflict; the committed value is kept and the item is listed on the Flagged for review page. PENDING = the official value is not yet published, so nothing is entered. Nothing is inferred or filled in. Limits: the fetch tool returns page text only (no HTTP status or response headers), and the sandbox cannot reach nfl.com directly, so counts over the full 8-chunk injury report were not re-derived line by line this session.

checks.item: 2026 Week 11 schedule: 13 games (matchup, kickoff, network) and 6 bye teams
checks.detail: Read chunks 0 and 1 of 2. Official page lists 13 games: IND at HOU (Thu 19 Nov 8:15 PM ET, Prime Video); MIA at BUF, BAL at CAR, NO at CHI, TEN at DAL, TB at DET, ARI at KC, PIT at PHI (Sun 22 Nov 1:00 PM ET); NYJ at LAC, JAX at NYG (4:05 / 4:25 PM ET); LV at DEN (4:25 PM ET); MIN at SF (Sun 8:20 PM ET); CIN at WAS (Mon 23 Nov 8:15 PM ET). Teams on bye: ATL, CLE, GB, LA, NE, SEA. All 13 matchups, kickoff times and the 6 byes match the committed slate row for row. Note: the page header above Sunday Night Football shows a 'Mexico City 2026' logo; the listed SNF game is MIN at SF and no Mexico City venue is printed for it, so no venue is inferred here.

checks.item: Correction test for flag FB-18: is J.J. McCarthy printed under the wrong club header?
checks.detail: The official player page lists McCarthy's club as New York Giants (status active). A nfl.com news item on the same page states: 'The Giants shipped a fifth-round pick to Minnesota for J.J. McCarthy earlier this season.' So the NYG header on the Week 10 report is correct for this player. FB-18's example is wrong; its other examples (Parsons, Franklin, Evans, Murray, Garrett) were not re-tested this session.
